args.title: Halvorsen Supply newsletter — Warehouse automation in 2026
args.body:
• Newsletter: Halvorsen Supply's latest issue covers "Warehouse automation in 2026" and links to the full article at blog.halvorsen.example/2026/warehouse.
• Article: Reports that pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts, but integration took twice as long as planned.
• Companion piece: Accessed via the registration link (registered with daniel.ferreira@northwind.example); its key finding is that the biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks.
